senses.gloss:
n. (-नं)
Eloquence, speaking well or elegantly.
E.
सु good, and वचन speech.

mfn. (-चाः-चाः-चः)
Speaking much, and eloquently or well.
E.
सु good, and वचस् speech.

m. (-नः)
1 The sun.
2 Fire.
3 The moon.
E.
षु to produce, Uṇādi aff. क्युन्.

mf. (-र्च्चका-र्च्चिका)
Natron, alkali.
E.
सु well, वर्च्च to shine, aff. ण्वुल्.

f. (-ला)
1 A wife of the sun.
2 Linseed, (Linum utilatissimum.)
m. (-लः)
A country so named.
E.
सु well, वर्च्च to shine, अलच् aff.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Of a good tribe or caste.
2 Brilliant, bright.
3 Of a good colour.
n. (-र्णं)
1 Gold.
2 A sort of Sandal wood.
3 A kind of red chalk or ochre.
4 Wealth, property.
5 A flower, (Mesua ferrea.)
mn. (-र्णः-र्णं)
A weight of gold, equal to sixteen Māṣas, which at five Rattis to each Māṣa makes the Suvarṇa equal to about 175 grains Troy.
m. (-र्णः)
1 A tree, (Cassia fistula.)
2 A sort of sacrifice.
f. (-र्णा)
1 Aloe wood, the black kind.
2 Turmeric.
3 A bitter gourd, (Colocynth.)
4 Sida, (Cordifolia, &c.)
E.
सु excellent, वर्ण tribe or colour, &c.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Cassia fistula.)
n. (-कं)
Lead.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-ली)
A sort of plantain bearing a bright yellow fruit.
E.
सुवर्ण gold, and कदली the plantain.

m. (-र्त्ता)
A goldsmith.
E.
सुवर्ण, and कर्त्तृ who makes.

m. (-रः)
A goldsmith.
E.
सुवर्ण gold, and कार a workman.

m. (-कृत्)
A goldsmith.
E.
सुवर्ण gold, and कृत् who makes.

n. (-तं)
(In arithmetic,) Allegation medial.
E.
सुवर्ण, and गणित calculation.

n. (-कं)
A variety of red chalk, a sort of ochre.
E.
सुवर्ण gold, and गैरिक red chalk.

m. (-रः)
A stealer of gold.
E.
सुवर्ण gold, and चौर theft.

f. (-थी)
Yellow jasmine.
E.
सुवर्ण gold, and यूथी jasmine.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Golden, having or being of gold.
2 Beautiful, handsome.
ind. (-वत्)
Like gold.
E.
सुवर्ण, and मतुप् or वति aff.

f. (-र्णा)
Turmeric.
E.
सुवर्ण gold, and वर्ण colour.

m. (-न्दुः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
सुवर्ण, gold, and विन्दु a dot or spot.

n. (-यं)
Stealing gold.
E.
सुवर्ण, and स्तेय theft.

m. (-ख्यः)
A flower, (Mesua ferrea.)
E.
सुवर्ण gold, and आख्या appellation.

f. (-ल्लिः-ल्ली)
A shrub, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
E.
सु excellent, and वल्ली a stalk.

mfn. (-वः)
What covers or clothes well.
E.
सु, वस to clothe, क्विप् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
The day of full moon in the month Chaitra, a festival in honour of KĀMADEVA.
E.
सु well, वसन्त spring; being in March-April.

m. (-कः)
1 A large creeper, (Gærtnera racemosa.)
2 A festival in honour of KĀMADEVA in the month of Chaitra.
E.
सु excellent, वसन्त the spring, and कन् added.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Bearing or conveying well or pleasantly.
2 Pleasant of burthen, to be borne with pleasure.
3 Patient, enduring.
f. (-हा)
1 A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.)
2 A shrub, (Mimosa octandra.)
3 Rasan, conjectured to be the ichneumon plant, (Ophiorrhyza mangos.)
4 A scandent shrub, (Cissus pedata.)
5 The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
6 A Vinā, or lute.
7 A medicinal plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum.)
E.
सु well, much, or pleasantly, and वह bearing.

m. (-सः)
1 A pleasant or reputable dwelling.
2 An agreeable perfume.
E.
सु good, and वास abode, &c.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Dwelling in a comfortable or respectable abode.
f. (-नी)
A woman married or unmarried, residing in her father's house.
E.
सु well, वास abode, इनि and ङीष् affs.

m. (-मः)
Prowess, valour.
E.
सु, and विक्रम power.

m. (-न्तः)
A hero.
n. (-न्तं)
Heroism, prowess.
E.
सु, and विक्रान्त valiant.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Very clever.
E.
सु, and विचक्षण intelligent.

m. (-रः)
Deliberate or due consideration.
E.
सु, and विचार consideration.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well-weighed, deliberately considered.
E.
सु, and विचारित considered.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well-known or understood.
E.
सु well, विदित known.

m. (-विद्)
A Paṇḍita, a learned man.
f. (-विद्)
A shrewd or clever woman.
E.
सु well, विद to know, aff. क्विप्.

m. (-दः)
An attendant on the women's apartments.
E.
सु well, विद to know, aff. क; also सौविद.

m. (-दः)
A king.
E.
सुविट् a Paṇḍita, अत to associate with, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Related, of kin, a kinsman, &c.
E.
सु well, विद to know, कचन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-ल्लं)
A haram, a seraglio.
f. (-ल्ला)
A woman.
E.
सुविदत् a king, ला to be or have, aff. ड, form irr.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Of a good kind, in a good or easy way.
n. (-धं)
Easily.
E.
सु, and विध kind.

m. (-धिः)
The ninth Jaina deified teacher of the present age.
E.
सु good, and विधि a precept.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well-trained, properly behaved.
f. (-ता)
A tractable cow.
E.
सु exceeding, and विनीत well-behaved.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Easily fusible, liquefying.
E.
सु and वि before ली to melt, अच् aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Trusty, confidential.
E.
सु, and विश्वस्त trusted in.

n. adv. (-रं)
Fully, at length.
E.
सु, and विस्तर expansion.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Well spread or laid out.
2 Very broad.
E.
सु, and विस्तीर्ण spread.

n. (-कं)
A collyrium, prepared from the Amomum anthorhizon.
E.
सु well, वीर power, efficacy, and कन् added.

n. (-म्लं)
Sour rice-gruel.
E.
सु very, वीर essence, अम्ल sour.

n. (-र्य्यं)
1 Great vigour.
2 The fruit of the jujube.
f. (-र्य्या)
Wild cotton.
E.
सु good, and वीर्य्य essence.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Virtuous, good.
2 Well or handsomely round.
E.
सु, and वृत्त practised, &c.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Bowed, bent, stooping.
2 Tamed, humble, quiet.
m. (-लः)
A mountain; also called Trikūṭa.
E.
सु well, and वेल to move or shake, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Well-dressed.
E.
सु, and वेश attire; also सुवेष.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Well-dressed, ornamented, decorated.
E.
सु excellent, वेष ornament, decoration, इनि poss. aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Plain, manifest.
n. adv. (-क्तं)
Evidently, clearly.
E.
सु, and व्यक्त manifested.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Dispersed.
E.
सु, and व्यस्त scattered.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Virtuous, strict, rigidly observing any religious vow or obligation.
m. (-तः)
1 The twentieth Jina of the present age; also named Munisuvrata.
2 One of the Jainas of the future era.
3 The religious student.
f. (-ता)
1 The mother of the fifteenth Jaina of the present age.
2 A cow easily milked, one of a tractable and gentle disposition.
3 A virtuous wife.
E.
सु well, good, व्रत a vow.
